pages.text: Sometimes plans change, or a hauler gets stuck in a link that no longer exists. If you need to clear the destination data from your Zephyr Hauler, you can $(2)Unbind$() it at any time.
Simply place your linked hauler anywhere in a $(2)Crafting Table$(). This action wipes the navigation memory safely.

pages.title: Result
pages.text: The hauler will return to an $(2)Unlinked$() state, ready to be programmed to a new destination dock. All your existing $(2)Upgrades$(), $(2)Color$(), and $(2)Durability$() stats will remain perfectly intact during this process.
